question: Free galaxy images with human morphology labels (bars, arms, bulge, mergers), at least 40k galaxies, for CNN training.

requirements.text: Detailed morphology: bars, spiral arms, bulge size, mergers
Labels from humans, not model predictions

record.title: Galaxy Zoo 2: Images from Original Sample
record.description: The Galaxy Zoo team regularly receives requests for subject images for various versions of Galaxy Zoo, in order to facilitate other investigations, e.g. machine learning projects. This repository is an updated attempt to provide those in a way that is useful to the wider community. The images here are meant to be used with the data tables available at data.galaxyzoo.org . They are the "original" sample of subject images in Galaxy Zoo 2 (Willett et al. 2013, MNRAS, 435, 2835, DOI: 10.1093/mnras/stt1458 ) as identified in Table 1 of Willett et al. and also in Hart et al. (2016, MNRAS, 461, 3663, DOI: 10.1093/mnras/stw1588 ). The original GZ2 subjects also gave the option to view an inverted v…

R2.evidence: GZ2 tree: bars, spiral arms, bulge size, mergers/odd

access_steps: Download images_gz2.zip (3.35 GB) and gz2_filename_mapping.csv from the Zenodo record
Download GZ2 Table 1 (Hart et al. 2016 debiased) CSV from data.galaxyzoo.org
caveats: Use the vote columns, not any model columns
Labels from the Zenodo catalogue record 3566991 are flagged restricted; use data.galaxyzoo.org instead (not verified further)

record.title: Galaxy Zoo DECaLS: Detailed Visual Morphology Measurements from Volunteers and Deep Learning for 314,000 Galaxies
record.description: This repository contains the data released in the paper "Galaxy Zoo DECaLS: Detailed Visual Morphology Measurements from Volunteers and Deep Learning for 314,000 Galaxies" (DOI to follow on publication). We release detailed morphology catalogues, both volunteer and automated, for Galaxy Zoo DECaLS. - gz_decals_volunteers_1_and_2 contains volunteer classifications for galaxies classified during the GZD-1 and GZD-2 campaigns. - gz_decals_volunteers_5 similarly contains classifications from the GZD-5 campaign. Note that GZD-5 used a modified schema designed to better detect mergers and weak bars, and includes many galaxies with only approx. five volunteer responses. - gz_decals_auto_posteriors…

record.title: Galaxy Zoo: Morphologies based on UKIDSS NIR Imaging for 71,052 Galaxies
record.description: Galaxy Zoo UKIDSS contains morphology measurements for 71,052 galaxies with YJK (1–2.4 μm) imaging from the United Kingdom Infrared Telescope Infrared Deep Sky Survey ( UKIDSS ). Galaxies were selected out of the Galaxy Zoo 2 (GZ2) sample, so also have classifications based on gri (0.48–0.76 μm) imaging from the Sloan Digital Sky Survey. An identical classification tree, and vote weighting/aggregation was applied to both UKIDSS and GZ2 classifications enabling direct comparisons. Masters et al. (2024) is an open access RNAAS publication which briefly describes this phase of Galaxy Zoo, which ran from 2013-2014 on the Galaxy Zoo site. not_recommended.name: Galaxy Zoo DESI (8.7M)
